summary.json from the first complete 576-cell run
reason: The implementation derived raw target distance from total unit loss including fees. Scaling costs therefore moved target prices and changed the economic strategy during cost stress, producing non-monotonic and non-comparable stress results.

fixed_contract.structural_price_risk: absolute distance between actual entry price and structural stop before fees
fixed_contract.raw_target: actual entry plus side times target_r times structural_price_risk
fixed_contract.cost_adjusted_rr: fees and slippage are applied after the raw structural target is fixed
fixed_contract.stress: the same signal, stop logic and target multiple are replayed; only actual entry/exit costs change
